messages:
Maya: :rotating_light: Seeing a spike of 503s for hosted inference in eu-west-1 - started ~1937654300. Dashboard shows upstream worker restarts and container evictions.
Tony: Which pool/model? any customer reports?
Maya: Affects 'redwood/llama-large-quant' on rtx-a100 pool; multiple customers complaining of timeouts/503s. Support escalations inbound.
Samir: I pulled logs from one pod, looks like CUDA OOM followed by SIGSEGV.
Samir: ```
[2026-03-15T12:05:31Z] runtime: throwing out-of-memory
CUDA error: out of memory
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
[signal SIGSEGV: segmentation violation]
#0 0x7f9d3c1a in fused_attention_forward(...) +0x1a3
#1 0x7f9d2f4b in infer_step(...) +0x2b
``` 
Leah: kubectl describe shows restartCount jumped from 1 to 15 in 10m.
Leah: ```
Container: inference-worker
Restart Count: 16
Last State: Terminated
  Reason: OOMKilled
  Exit Code: 137
``` 
Maya: Deploy-bot shows we rolled runtime:v2.3.1 at 1937654000, this started ~30m after.
Tony: Could be regression in fused attention kernels in v2.3.1. Any recent kernel/driver changes on nodes?
Samir: Nodes have nvidia-driver 525.85 and CUDA 12.1. No driver roll in the window.
Samir: Repro script I ran: 50 concurrent requests with max_tokens=4096 and batch_size=8 triggers OOM on a single A100-80GB.
Samir: ```bash
# repro
for i in {1..50}; do 
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -d '{"model":"llama-large-quant","input":"<long prompt>","max_tokens":4096,"batch_size":8}' &
done
``` 
Leah: Immediate mitigations: 1) drain affected nodes, 2) route traffic to eu-west-2, 3) reduce default max_tokens to 2048 for that model via runtime flag.
Maya: I've applied a runtime guard limiting batch_size to 4 and max_tokens to 2048 for canary routing. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployed guard config to canary subset (10% traffic) at 1937654360
Samir: After guard, restarts dropped to 0 in canary subset. Full pool still noisy.
Tony: For full rollback options: revert runtime v2.3.1 to v2.3.0 or hotfix fused attention. Any quick patch candidate?
Samir: There's a suspected commit 9f3b7c that touched memory pooling. I can build a hotfix image with the pool fix and run in canary.
Maya: SupportBot, send status update to impacted customers: brief, include ETA and mitigation steps.
SupportBot: Sent update to customers at 1937654375: "We're aware of 503s; mitigations applied (traffic routing + limits). Working on hotfix; ETA 2h. Contact support for priority cases."
Leah: Action items:
- Samir: build + smoke test hotfix image (9f3b7c revert) and canary deploy (ETA 45m)
- Tony: validate autoscaler memory settings + add OOM alert threshold
- Maya: coordinate customer comms and update incident page
Samir: building image now, pushing to canary registry. logs show small mem leak when seq_len>2048, likely accumulation in attention cache.
Samir: ```
[INFO] mem_usage_gb=14.2 seq_len=2048
[INFO] mem_usage_gb=30.8 seq_len=4096
[WARN] leaked_pages=512
``` 
Maya: Good repro. If hotfix goes well we'll do rolling patch. If not, plan B revert to v2.3.0 and emergency capacity in eu-west-2.
Tony: Also add a short-term rate-limit per-API-key for affected models to protect capacity.
Leah: Will attach heap/profile from a crash pod to the ticket. Samir, please include the exact curl commands and the pod-id for reproduction.
Samir: pod id inference-worker-7fd9c I uploaded heap dump to S3 s3://redwood-debug/1937654321/heap-inference-worker-7fd9c.hprof
Maya: Thanks all. I'll keep public status and Slack updates. ping @oncall-bot if we see >5% error-rate again.
oncall-bot: Alert rule triggered: upstream_worker_restarts > 10 in 10m at 1937654330 :rotating_light:
Maya: Incident owner: Maya. Tracking ticket INC-9421. :clipboard:
Tony: tl;dr - regression after runtime v2.3.1 causing GPU memory blowup on long-seq requests, mitigated by limits+canary, hotfix in progress.
Leah: Closing loop with support once hotfix passes canary. If rollback needed, I'll coordinate with infra for capacity adds.
Maya: Thanks team. I'll post a postmortem draft after resolution.
